name: PractitionerEverything
title: Fetch Practitioner Record
description: Returns every resource in the Practitioner compartment of the practitioner on which it is invoked (CompartmentDefinition/practitioner), with the practitioner itself, as a searchset Bundle. Modelled on HL7's Patient-everything, which R4B defines for Patient, Encounter, Group and MedicinalProductDefinition only; this server offers the same operation on every compartment it holds and publishes its own definition for the three R4B does not define.
comment: _type restricts the result to the named resource types; _since returns only resources changed since that instant; _count and _offset page the result. The date range parameters (start, end) of Patient-everything are not offered.

parameter.name: _type
parameter.documentation: One or more resource types to include, comma-separated; all compartment types when absent.

name: FhirPath
title: Evaluate a FHIRPath expression
description: Evaluates a FHIRPath expression against one resource: a stored one named by resourceType and resourceId, or the resource sent as the request body. Returns the result collection as a JSON array of values. The evaluation runs in a worker isolate under the server's program deadline; an expression that does not finish in time is a 422 too-costly.
comment: GET [base]/$fhirpath?expression=...&resourceType=...&resourceId=..., or POST [base]/$fhirpath?expression=... with the resource as the body. Not a Parameters-based operation.

parameter.name: resourceType
parameter.documentation: With resourceId, the stored resource to evaluate against.

parameter.name: resourceId
parameter.documentation: With resourceType, the stored resource to evaluate against.

parameter.name: resource
parameter.documentation: The request body: the resource to evaluate against when no stored one is named.

parameter.name: return
parameter.documentation: The result collection, as a JSON array.
